topic_description: Research studies about the usage of AI in schools for education purpose. Include papers show how AI can be used for education purposes during the school time in a classroom. Exclude papers that focus on the different technological implementations of AI. Focus on the different ways of how to use AI in schools and on the impact this has on learning and the students.
provider_reason: OpenAlex is a broad scholarly search provider suitable for finding diverse research across disciplines.
search_goal: To identify approximately 30 scholarly papers that explore the applications and impacts of AI in educational settings within schools, excluding technical implementations.
main_search_string: AI usage in schools for education purposes
alternate_search_strings: AI impact on students in schools
Educational applications of AI in schools
Using AI to enhance learning in classrooms

provider_specific_plan.query: AI usage in schools for education purposes

filters.name: from_publication_date
filters.reason: To focus on recent studies from 2018 onwards.

filters.name: to_publication_date
filters.reason: No upper limit specified, allowing for the most current research.

filters.name: has_abstract
filters.reason: The topic contract excludes candidates without abstracts, so the provider query should retrieve works with abstracts.

filters.name: type
filters.reason: The topic contract excludes review/background papers, so OpenAlex review works are filtered before screening.

screening_notes: Look for studies that discuss practical applications of AI in educational contexts, focusing on classroom dynamics and student engagement, avoiding overly technical papers that delve into AI systems themselves.
risks_or_ambiguities: The search may yield papers that are too technical despite exclusions.
Terminology variations in the context of AI usage in education might affect results.
